This script creates a .bib file with all references used across the scripts in this project. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, messages = FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = 'C:/Users/Kate S/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/AFS Value Added 2023')

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(citr) ## To install from github: devtools::install_github("crsh/citr")

# Set relative directory paths
  scripts <- file.path(".", "Scripts")
  support <- file.path(".", "Support files and scripts")

# Citation management
citr::tidy_bib_file(
  rmd_file = c("Scripts/2_AFS Val Added_SNA data.rmd", "Scripts/3_AFS Val Added_UNIDO Manufacturing data.rmd",
               "Scripts/4_AFS Val Added_EORA data and fraction calculation.rmd"),
  messy_bibliography = "Scripts/Agrifood Value Added.bib", #updated by Zotero
  file = file.path(support, "references.bib") #.bib file with only references actually referenced
)

```
